description:
Desert Does It is a leading innovator in aftermarket auto parts and accessories, specializing in high-quality, American-made parts that enhance the driving experience in comfort and organization. Known for our pioneering product, the Seat Jacker, we cater to drivers seeking comfort and functionality in their vehicle setup.

The Seat Jacker, our flagship product, is meticulously designed to elevate the driver's seat for improved visibility and comfort, making it a must-have for enthusiasts and everyday drivers alike.

Always made, manufactured, and distributed in the USA using locally sourced materials, the Seat Jacker is the only seat riser on the market that boasts crash testing certifications, ensuring safety is never compromised for comfort. This commitment to quality and safety sets the Seat Jacker apart in a market flooded with inferior alternatives.

Recognizing the passion our customers have for both their vehicles and our products, we launched the Desert Does It Affiliate Program, designed to empower auto enthusiasts and influencers to earn by sharing their favorite Desert Does It products. The program offers a lucrative opportunity for affiliates to generate revenue through a tiered commission structure, rewarding members for their sales achievements and dedication.

Starting at the Pathfinder Tier, affiliates earn a competitive 5% commission and can provide their followers with a 10% discount. As sales increase, affiliates automatically advance to higher tiers—Trail Boss and Summit Ranger—where they can earn up to 12% commission. Each tier includes a tailored discount for deeper market penetration and increased sales potential.

Joining the Desert Does It Affiliate Program not only means becoming part of a brand that stands for quality and innovation but also offers the chance to grow your own brand and earnings. Whether you’re just starting out or are looking to expand your influence in the automotive world, our program is designed to support your journey towards success. Sign up today and start driving your passion into profit with Desert Does It.
